prompt:
Locked-off camera, framing holds. From the first half-second all six perform to the lens on the beat. The man in front chops his flat glove down onto his heap of notes, beat after beat; on the third beat he looks up and gives a slow, smug shrug. Behind him the five bounce at the knees, free gloves jabbing toward the lens on each beat, then all heave their barrow handles up together and drop them. Wheelbarrows and notes stay in place; masks, hats and suits stay exactly as they are. The old clerk keeps typing, never looking up. SFX: thumps on paper, clattering keys, a vault hum.

Thanks.
